perks.name: Cornered

Throwing a grenade or hitting a target with a charged melee grants a stacking bonus to weapon stability, handling, and range.

perks.name: Steady Hands

perks.name: Heating Up

perks.name: Stats for All

perks.name: Lead from Gold

perks.name: Feeding Frenzy

perks.name: Ensemble

perks.name: Compulsive Reloader

perks.name: Perpetual Motion

perks.name: Field Prep

perks.name: Chill Clip
perks.desc: Direct hits with the top half of the magazine cause a detonation that slows nearby targets.

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.desc: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.

perks.name: Crystalline Corpsebloom
perks.desc: Rapid final blows spawn a [Stasis] Stasis crystal near the victim's location.

perks.name: Closing Time
perks.desc: Improves range, accuracy, and handling as the magazine gets lower.

perks.name: Controlled Burst
perks.desc: Landing every shot in a burst grants this weapon increased damage and reduced charge time for a short duration.

perks.name: Collective Pugilism
perks.desc:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of melee energy generation on hit. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

perks.name: Golden Tricorn
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. While this buff is active, grenade or melee kills of the same damage type greatly increase its damage and duration.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.desc: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Snapshot Sights
perks.desc: Faster time to aim down sights.

perks.name: Wellspring
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon generate ability energy. This energy is divided between your uncharged abilities.

perks.name: Cornered
perks.desc: Faster charge time or draw time when surrounded by combatants.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Successful Warm-Up
perks.desc: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed.

perks.name: Unrelenting
perks.desc: Rapidly defeating targets triggers health regeneration. Guardians and powerful combatants count as more than one kill.

perks.name: Harmony
perks.desc: Final blows with other weapons improve this weapon's damage and performance for a short duration.

perks.name: Thresh
perks.desc: Killing combatants with this weapon generates a small amount of Super energy.

perks.name: Golden Tricorn Enhanced
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage for an improved duration. While this buff is active, grenade or melee final blows of the same damage type greatly increase its damage for an improved duration.

perks.name: Accelerated Assault
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage with this weapon loads a small amount of ammo from reserves, or removes heat, and slightly increases damage.

perks.name: Roar of Battle
perks.desc: Being in combat for a short duration increases handling and stability.

perks.name: Wild Card
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon have a chance to create experimental submunitions at the target's location.

perks.name: One Quiet Moment
perks.desc: Grants increased reload speed and handling when out of combat. Swords gain faster movement speed.

notes: Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Utility PvE-EndGame PvE-Champion PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE utility roll to deal with Overload and Unstoppable Champions in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty, particularly for Stasis builds. Riptide is a rapid-fire fusion rifle, which are rated F-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic tiering spreadsheet https://linktr.ee/TheAegisRelic being a "strict downgrade from high-impact and precision frames for boss damage". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Overload, better total ammo reserves and a ×0.8 reload animation scalar when the battery is empty as per the https://www.destiny2.science/ Destiny Data Compendium. The stats are good by comparison with its peers - you can see them at https://destiny.report/w/2297554989/riptide and hopefully https://d2foundry.gg/w/2297554989 will show how weapon stats impact in-game performance when the site is back up and running. With 9 bolts to control, look for a barrel perk that helps with recoil control together with any other stat that you want to bump. As the battery perk, Accelerated Coils improves charge time by 40ms at the cost of ×0.98 base damage, or Enhanced Battery gets you to the maximum of 8 shots. To replace your older utility Riptide - Overflow in the first trait perk column overflows the battery by ×2 (×2.2 when enhanced), rounded up, on picking up an ammo brick. That pairs well in the second column with Chill Clip which applies +40 stacks of slow (freezing targets after 3 hits) within a 4m AoE for 4s on a hit - 8s with Whisper of Durance - with ammo in the top half of the base battery size. With an overflowed battery, that means 10 Chill Clip shots. Alternatively, Crystalline Corpsebloom procs on a kill to provide a 4s buff - kills with the buff active generate a Stasis seeker which travels 3m before spawning a medium Stasis crystal (large when enhanced) - these are weapon-generated entities so can inherit damage buffs, and proc subclass fragments when shattered for AoE damage. You'll already disrupt Overloads with the frame intrinsic, and shattering after freezing an Unstoppable will stun it, so you can handle two champion types with one weapon. If you're lucky you'll drop one with the Accelerated Assault origin trait, which passively reloads 10% of the battery and boosts damage by ×1.05 for getting 3 hits within a 1.6s window. Otherwise, there's a choice of Wild Card for the chance of Telesto-like "Experimental Submunitions" dropping on a kill - the number depends on the enemy tier - that last up to 10.5s and explode on contact or proximity to an enemy or Roar of Battle which grants +10 Stability and Handling for 6s after dealing or taking damage every 0.5s or so for 2s. Recommended MW: Charge Time, with a Charge Time mod or your preferred choice to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds.

Inspired by https://www.youtube.com/@Legoleflash (PvP PvP-Duel PvP-God M+KB Controller): God-roll PvP for duelling in 3s and 6s. The reprised Riptide is, at time of writing, an S-Tier special option - the fastest long-range fusion rifle and one Lego describes as "the only fusion rifle I want to take into Crucible". The @hugowo_ spreadsheet at https://www.destiny2.science/, shows a base charge time for rapid-fire fusions of 533ms - nerfed from 500ms in the v9.5.0 patch and a 7-bolt kill, out of 9 bolts fired. In practice, it's difficult to detect any charge time nerf in-game, though. The stats aren't great compared to other rapid fire fusions, but as the only one that offers tiered rolls, you can get enhanced barrel, mag, weapon mods and origin traits to fill all of the stat gaps at Tiers 4 and 5 - that means a Range that's potentially 17 more than the previous version's max. You can see the in-game effect of stat changes at https://d2foundry.gg/w/2297554989 for yourself. Range with the barrel and battery perks is key to controlling the recoil - ideally without any stat penalties. In the first trait perk column, Under Pressure seem like the obvious pick, for the improved stability and accuracy at the bottom of the battery - and it is really good, but if you can put together two Ferropotent and two Twofold Crown armour pieces together, you open up the option of Overflow for instant ammo refills on ammo pickup. Ferropotent ×2 gains both flinch and damage resistance while your shields regenerate, while Twofold Crown ×2 restores 70HP on ammo pickup, which all combine for a go-faster play loop demonstrated in Lego's video. A third option is Built to Blast - given how easy Woven Mail, Frost Armor or Void Overshields are to generate, the additional stability and Aim Assist are very noticable. In the second column Closing Time is the best choice, adding +10 Range, +25 Handling and a ×0.90 handling animation scalar at max effect. Both Origin Traits are useful - Roar of Battle procs after dealing or receiving damage consistently every 0.65s for 2s boosts handling and stability by +10 each for 6s (7s when enhanced), or Wild Card generates 3 Telesto-like bolts on a Guardian kill which persist for 10.5s or until detonated to soften or finish opponents, with a 6s cooldown between procs. Recommended MW: Charge Time, with a Range enhanced mod, or your choice depending on your play style.

The stats aren't great compared to other rapid fire fusions, but as the only one that offers tiered rolls, you can get enhanced barrel, mag, weapon mods and origin traits to fill all of the stat gaps at Tiers 4 and 5 - that means a Range that's potentially 17 more than the previous version's max. You can see the in-game effect of stat changes at https://d2foundry.gg/w/1323862250 for yourself. Range with the barrel and battery perks is key to controlling the recoil - ideally without any stat penalties. In the first trait perk column, Under Pressure seem like the obvious pick, for the improved stability and accuracy at the bottom of the battery - and it is really good, but if you can put together two Ferropotent and two Twofold Crown armour pieces together, you open up the option of Overflow for instant ammo refills on ammo pickup. Ferropotent ×2 gains both flinch and damage resistance while your shields regenerate, while Twofold Crown ×2 restores 70HP on ammo pickup, which all combine for a go-faster play loop demonstrated in Lego's video. A third option is Built to Blast - given how easy Woven Mail, Frost Armor or Void Overshields are to generate, the additional stability and Aim Assist are very noticable. In the second column Closing Time is the best choice, adding +10 Range, +25 Handling and a ×0.90 handling animation scalar at max effect. Both Origin Traits are useful - Roar of Battle procs after dealing or receiving damage consistently every 0.65s for 2s boosts handling and stability by +10 each for 6s (7s when enhanced), or Wild Card generates 3 Telesto-like bolts on a Guardian kill which persist for 10.5s or until detonated to soften or finish opponents, with a 6s cooldown between procs. Recommended MW: Charge Time, with a Range enhanced mod, or your choice depending on your play style.
